pages.text:
七月二号的早晨，咘咘一睁开眼睛，就看见房间里飘满了彩色气球，门框上还挂着一条长长的彩虹彩带。
"哇——！"咘咘从床上跳起来，"今天是我的生日！"
pages.text_en:
On the morning of July 2nd, Bubu opened her eyes and saw colorful balloons floating all over the room, with a long rainbow streamer hanging from the doorway.
"Wow!" Bubu jumped out of bed. "Today is my birthday!"

pages.text:
爸爸和妈妈已经在客厅等着她了。妈妈抱起咘咘转了一个圈："生日快乐，我们的小宝贝！三岁啦！"
爸爸笑着揉揉咘咘的耳朵："我们的小兔子又长大一岁了。"
pages.text_en:
Dad and Mom were already waiting in the living room. Mom picked Bubu up and spun her around: "Happy birthday, our little darling! You're three!"
Dad smiled and gently rubbed Bubu's ears: "Our little bunny is one year older."

pages.text:
"叮咚——"门铃响了！咘咘跑去开门，门外站着两个她从没见过的客人。
一个是圆圆胖胖、浅绿色的小恐龙，笑眯眯地蹲下来看着咘咘。旁边是一只浅棕色的小猴子，眼睛里满满都是爱。
"咘咘，这是爷爷和奶奶呀！"爸爸在身后说。
pages.text_en:
"Ding dong!" The doorbell rang! Bubu ran to open the door and saw two visitors she'd never met before.
A round, chubby light-green dinosaur crouched down with a warm smile. Beside him was a light-brown monkey with eyes full of love.
"Bubu, these are Grandpa and Grandma!" Dad said from behind.

pages.text:
爷爷把咘咘轻轻抱起来，小恐龙的手虽然短短的，但抱得好紧好稳。"咘咘长这么大啦，爷爷好想你呀。"
奶奶在旁边眯着眼睛笑，伸出灵巧的小手摸摸咘咘的头："真是越长越漂亮了。"
pages.text_en:
Grandpa gently picked Bubu up. His little dinosaur arms were short, but his hug was tight and steady. "Bubu is so big now. Grandpa missed you so much."
Grandma smiled with her eyes, reaching out her nimble little hand to pat Bubu's head: "You're getting prettier every day."

pages.text:
门铃又响了！这次进来的是两只粉红色的火烈鸟——一只高高的，穿着漂亮的裙子，一只小小的，蹦蹦跳跳的。
"干妈！小乔姐姐！"妈妈开心地迎上去。
小乔姐姐跑到咘咘面前，拉着她的手说："咘咘妹妹，生日快乐！我们带了一个超级大的礼物给你！"
pages.text_en:
The doorbell rang again! This time, two pink flamingos walked in — one tall and elegant in a pretty dress, and one small and bouncy.
"Godmother! Xiaoqiao!" Mom greeted them happily.
Xiaoqiao ran to Bubu and held her hand: "Happy birthday, Bubu! We brought you a super big present!"

pages.text:
不一会儿，猪猪姐姐一家也来了！猪猪的爸爸妈妈抱着一个好大好大的蛋糕盒子，猪猪姐姐跑在最前面。
"咘咘！生日快乐！"猪猪姐姐张开毛茸茸的小蹄子，给了咘咘一个大大的拥抱。
蛋糕是粉色的，上面有三根小蜡烛和一只糖霜小兔子。
pages.text_en:
Soon, Zhuzhu's family arrived too! Zhuzhu's parents carried a huge cake box, while Zhuzhu ran ahead.
"Bubu! Happy birthday!" Zhuzhu opened her fluffy little hooves and gave Bubu a big hug.
The cake was pink, decorated with three little candles and a frosted sugar bunny.

pages.text:
"来，先拆干妈的礼物！"小乔姐姐拉着咘咘跑到院子里，那里放着一个用大蝴蝶结包起来的巨大包裹。
咘咘拆开一看——是一个蓝色的大蹦床！
"哇啊啊啊！！"咘咘的眼睛瞪得圆圆的，嘴巴张成了一个大大的O。
pages.text_en:
"Come, open Godmother's gift first!" Xiaoqiao pulled Bubu to the yard, where a huge package wrapped with a big bow sat.
Bubu unwrapped it — it was a big blue trampoline!
"WOOOW!!!" Bubu's eyes went round as saucers, her mouth forming a big O.

pages.text:
咘咘立刻爬上蹦床，开始蹦啊蹦啊蹦！小乔姐姐也跳了上来，两个人手拉手一起蹦。
"再高一点！再高一点！"咘咘笑得停不下来，耳朵在空中飞来飞去。
NOMI在旁边拍手，NONO在空中绕着她们飞圈圈。
pages.text_en:
Bubu climbed onto the trampoline right away and started bouncing! Xiaoqiao jumped on too, and they held hands bouncing together.
"Higher! Higher!" Bubu laughed non-stop, her ears flapping in the air.
NOMI clapped nearby while NONO flew in circles around them.

pages.text:
蹦够了以后，爸爸神秘地拿出一个长长的盒子："这是爸爸妈妈送给咘咘的礼物。"
咘咘拆开一看，是一根漂亮的小鱼竿！
"以后爸爸带你去钓鱼，好不好？"爸爸蹲下来问。
"好！我要钓一条大大大大的鱼！"咘咘举着鱼竿开心地比划着。
pages.text_en:
After bouncing enough, Dad mysteriously brought out a long box: "This is a gift from Mom and Dad."
Bubu opened it — a beautiful little fishing rod!
"I'll take you fishing. How about that?" Dad crouched down and asked.
"Yes! I want to catch a really really big fish!" Bubu waved the fishing rod excitedly.

pages.text:
到了下午，大家一起把蛋糕放在桌子中间，插上三根蜡烛，点燃了小小的火苗。
所有人围在咘咘身边，一起唱："祝你生日快乐，祝你生日快乐——"
外公外婆、爷爷奶奶、爸爸妈妈、干妈小乔姐姐、猪猪一家……每个人脸上都是笑容。
pages.text_en:
In the afternoon, everyone placed the cake in the center of the table and lit three candles with tiny flames.
Everyone gathered around Bubu and sang: "Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you..."
Grandpa, Grandma, Yeye, Nainai, Dad, Mom, Godmother, Xiaoqiao, Zhuzhu's family... everyone was smiling.

pages.text:
"咘咘，许个愿吧。"妈妈温柔地说。
咘咘闭上眼睛，双手合在一起。她许了一个小小的愿望，然后——"呼——"三根蜡烛全部吹灭了！
大家一起鼓掌："好棒！咘咘好厉害！"
pages.text_en:
"Bubu, make a wish," Mom said gently.
Bubu closed her eyes and put her hands together. She made a little wish, then — "Whooo" — all three candles went out!
Everyone clapped: "Amazing! Bubu is so great!"

pages.text:
吃蛋糕的时候，咘咘的小嘴巴沾满了粉色的奶油。爷爷也偷偷在自己圆圆的鼻子上点了一坨奶油，逗得咘咘哈哈大笑。
奶奶用纸巾帮爷爷擦鼻子，笑着说："你看你，比咘咘还调皮。"
pages.text_en:
While eating cake, Bubu's little mouth was covered in pink frosting. Grandpa sneakily dabbed some cream on his own round nose, making Bubu laugh out loud.
Grandma wiped Grandpa's nose with a napkin, laughing: "Look at you, even naughtier than Bubu."

pages.text:
晚餐时间，大大的圆桌上摆满了好吃的菜。咘咘坐在爸爸和妈妈中间，左边是爷爷奶奶，右边是外公外婆，对面是干妈、小乔姐姐和猪猪一家。
满满一桌人，满满一桌爱。
pages.text_en:
At dinner time, the big round table was full of delicious dishes. Bubu sat between Dad and Mom, with Yeye and Nainai on one side, Waigong and Waipo on the other, and Godmother, Xiaoqiao, and Zhuzhu's family across.
A full table of people, a full table of love.

pages.text:
客人们一个一个离开了。猪猪姐姐在门口和咘咘拉钩钩："下次一起玩蹦床！"小乔姐姐亲了亲咘咘的额头："姐姐还会来看你的。"
爷爷奶奶最后才走，奶奶抱着咘咘好久都不想松手："咘咘要乖乖的哦。"
pages.text_en:
The guests left one by one. Zhuzhu made a pinky promise with Bubu at the door: "Let's play on the trampoline together next time!" Xiaoqiao kissed Bubu's forehead: "I'll come visit again."
Yeye and Nainai were the last to leave. Nainai held Bubu for a long time, not wanting to let go: "Be a good girl, Bubu."

pages.text:
晚上，咘咘躺在床上，NOMI坐在床边，NONO停在枕头旁。
"NOMI，今天好开心呀。"咘咘小声说，"爷爷好好玩，奶奶好温柔，小乔姐姐也好好……还有蹦床！"
"嗯，因为大家都很爱咘咘呀。"NOMI轻轻说。
咘咘抱着NOMI的手，慢慢闭上了眼睛，嘴角还挂着一个小小的微笑。
三岁的第一天，真是最最最幸福的一天。
pages.text_en:
That night, Bubu lay in bed. NOMI sat beside her, and NONO perched by the pillow.
"NOMI, today was so much fun," Bubu whispered. "Grandpa was so funny, Grandma was so gentle, Xiaoqiao was so nice... and the trampoline!"
"That's because everyone loves Bubu so much," NOMI said softly.
Bubu held NOMI's paw and slowly closed her eyes, a little smile still on her lips.
The first day of being three was truly the happiest day ever.
